fact: The National Authority for Remote Sensing, with the agriculture ministry, produced crop maps for winter 2023/24 (wheat, clover, sugar beet) and summer 2024 for the governorates using remote sensing and AI, allowing crop growth to be monitored through the season with vegetation indices.
title: الإعلان عن أبرز المشروعات الزراعية باستخدام "الاستشعار من البعد والذكاء الاصطناعي"
